import json, torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoConfig
torch.set_num_threads(8)
for d in ["/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base","/app/merged_model"]:
    c = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(d)
    print(d, "arch:", c.architectures, "num_labels:", c.num_labels, "type:", type(c).__name__)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model"); m.eval()
print("merged labels:", m.config.id2label)
# fresh, from-disk predictions vs the saved json
saved = json.load(open("/app/detection_results.json"))
ok = 0
for r in saved:
    inp = tok(r["text"], return_tensors="pt", truncation=True)
    with torch.no_grad(): lg = m(**inp).logits[0]
    cid = int(torch.argmax(lg))
    p = float(torch.softmax(lg, -1)[cid])
    match = cid == r["predicted_class_id"]
    ok += match
    print(f"{match} reload={cid}({p:.4f}) json={r['predicted_class_id']} {m.config.id2label[cid]} {r['text'][:28]}")
print(f"reload matches json: {ok}/{len(saved)}")
# extra languages not in the test set
for t in ["Dzień dobry, jak się masz?","Merhaba, nasılsın?","สวัสดี สบายดีไหม","Habari, hujambo?"]:
    inp = tok(t, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True)
    with torch.no_grad(): lg = m(**inp).logits[0]
    cid=int(torch.argmax(lg)); print(f"  extra {m.config.id2label[cid]:>2} {float(torch.softmax(lg,-1)[cid]):.3f}  {t}")
EOF

bash: cd /app && timeout 900 python - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | grep -v "Loading weights" | tail -20
import os, json, torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
torch.set_num_threads(8)
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"]="1"; os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"]="1"
# 1. base configured model loads from /app/model_cache and is a 20-way classifier
m0 = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base")
print("cache model out_features:", m0.classifier.out_proj.out_features, "nlabels:", m0.config.num_labels)
print("head trained (abs mean >0.005):", float(m0.classifier.out_proj.weight.abs().mean()) > 0.005)
# 2. merged model from disk gives the saved predictions
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model")
m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("/app/merged_model"); m.eval()
res = json.load(open("/app/detection_results.json"))
acc = 0
for r in res:
    lg = m(**tok(r["text"], return_tensors="pt", truncation=True)).logits[0]
    acc += int(torch.argmax(lg)) == r["predicted_class_id"]
print(f"offline reload agreement: {acc}/{len(res)}")
print("keys ok:", all(k in r for r in res for k in ("text","predicted_class_id","confidence")))
EOF
